study: Polymarket International vs Gemini: habitat, chain, and L5-conditioned control

hypothesis.H0: comparable reaching-flow conditions; the problem is implementation
hypothesis.H1: International gives materially more frequent reaching two-sided flow at tight spreads, letting the same passive mechanism recycle
hypothesis.verdict: H1 SUPPORTED, on the discriminating observation and not on volume

data_provenance.polymarket_L2: Zenodo record 22084977 updown_15m.parquet, 1-second full L2 ladders, 2026-08-21..24, 239,310 snapshots, 265 markets; 33 are BTC 15m
data_provenance.polymarket_fills: L5 on-chain fill corpus, 763,966 fills; 13,592 BTC 5m/15m windows. CONFIRMED EXECUTIONS.
data_provenance.gemini: corrected symmetric-queue corpus, 59 contracts, 1,096 book states, ~8s controller cycles, real public tape
data_provenance.granularity: Polymarket L2 is 1s, Gemini is ~8s. Every rate metric is reported for Polymarket BOTH natively AND downsampled to 8s; only the 8s column is compared with Gemini.
data_provenance.scope_mismatch: The Zenodo L2 covers 15m only. The Gemini corpus is 58 BTC5m + 1 BTC15m. Both are short-duration crypto up/down binaries but the durations are not matched, and this is not corrected for.
NOT_OBSERVABLE: L5's own queue position -- the book is anonymous and his resting orders are not identifiable. Not synthesized.
A market-wide Polymarket trade tape. `logs_seen` in the backfill is L5-address-filtered, not market-wide, so prints/minute for all participants is NOT measured and no figure is given for it.

spread_headline.note: At matched 8s sampling the two books move at almost the SAME rate (touch changes/min 4.88 vs 5.18) and Gemini has MORE depth at the touch (217 vs 80). Gemini is not a quiet or thin book. It is a WIDE one.

the_discriminator.definition: A resting BUY at p can only fill if the market offers at or below p. From BOOK ONLY, on the same field on both venues: does best_ask later come down to <= the bid touch of this state? No tape and no queue assumption is used.
the_discriminator.reading: 4.5x more likely to be reached, and 3.7x faster when it is.

arm_A_feasible.polymarket: 5.1% of states leave room to improve by a tick without crossing

mirror_image.reading: The venues fail in opposite ways. On Gemini the front of the queue is FREE (a 28c spread means you step in front for a penny, every time) and nobody ever comes. On Polymarket the front is UNOBTAINABLE (a 1c spread means joining the touch behind ~65 contracts) and the flow arrives anyway, so the queue drains. L5 is not winning a queue race; he is standing in a queue that moves.

extends_before_completing.reading: a one-pair lifecycle would be the wrong model; two thirds of the time he adds to the same side first

l5_conditioned.second_fill_mechanism: 26.4% of L5's maker fills in the L2 overlap price at or above the prevailing best ask, which a resting bid cannot do. Prior work identified these as complete-set MINTS: two buyers of opposite outcomes matched by minting $1, needing no offer on his own book, only a counterparty bidding the complement at >= 1-p. Gemini has no such mechanism. (analysis/l5/historical_l2/ZENODO_OVERLAP_FINDINGS.md)

median_time_first_fill_to_matched.gemini: n=5, too few to quote a median

corrections_to_earlier_reporting.claim: COMPLETE fills are zero in every Gemini spread bucket
corrections_to_earlier_reporting.why: that counter keys on the rung's LABEL at placement. A rung placed as OPEN that fills after inventory has moved creates matched inventory while never being labelled COMPLETE.
corrections_to_earlier_reporting.correct: 5 of 28 A+B first fills (17.9%) reached matched inventory.

corrections_to_earlier_reporting.why: the tracer observed `live` at the END of each cycle, and a rung that FILLS is removed from `live` before the hook sees it, so the counter systematically missed exactly the successful cases.
corrections_to_earlier_reporting.correct: 6 of 28 (21.4%) saw reaching flow: 5 filled, 1 did not clear the queue.

corrections_to_earlier_reporting.why: the segment loop never appended a zero-residual step, so the COMPLETED branch was unreachable.

target_profile_for_the_PMUS_sports_searc.spread: median <= 2c; >= 95% of states at or below 2c
target_profile_for_the_PMUS_sports_searc.reach: >= 70% of resting-bid states reached by the ask within 120s at 8s sampling; median wait <= 30s
target_profile_for_the_PMUS_sports_searc.touch_depth: small enough to drain within the window -- Polymarket's median 65 contracts drains in ~26s on BTC15m
target_profile_for_the_PMUS_sports_searc.flow: two-sided; a participant can record 8+ fills per minute
target_profile_for_the_PMUS_sports_searc.anti_criterion: do NOT select on spread alone. Gemini has comparable touch-change rate and MORE depth, and still cannot recycle. Reach is the binding metric.

labels: OFFLINE OBSERVATION ONLY. No International execution was attempted, no order was sent, and no Gemini, Model A or shadow execution code was modified. Gemini rows are HYPOTHETICAL rungs; Polymarket rows are L5's confirmed on-chain fills. Nothing here is realized P&L.
